_meta.title: Tubing Reference Data
_meta.description: Edit this file to add/remove tubing sizes or grades — any field you add to an entry shows up on the Tubing page automatically. Standard fields: size (nominal OD), od_in, grade, thread, weight_lb_ft, coupling_od_in, tube_id_in, drift_id_in, wall_thickness_in, capacity_bbl_ft, stretch_coefficient (used by the Unset TAC calculator, not shown on the page by default).
_meta.source: API 5CT tubing dimensions, common weight/grade combination for rod-pumped wells
